items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Honeybees do far more than make honey. As they fly from flower to flower collecting nectar, they carry pollen with them. This pollen lets many plants grow the fruits and seeds we eat. Apples, almonds, blueberries, and many other crops depend on bees. Without honeybees, farmers would struggle to grow much of the food on our tables.

Which sentence best states the central idea of the passage?
items.answer: Honeybees play a vital role in growing much of the food that people eat.

steps: The central idea is the main point the author develops across the whole passage, not just the topic.
Every detail (carrying pollen, helping crops grow, farmers struggling without them) supports one big point.
That point is that honeybees are important to the food people eat.
So the central idea is: Honeybees play a vital role in growing much of the food that people eat.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

The topic of a piece of writing is the subject it is about, usually named in a word or short phrase. The central idea is the main point the author makes about that topic. For example, 'volcanoes' is a topic, but 'Volcanoes can both destroy land and create new land' is a central idea.

In your own words, explain the difference between a topic and a central idea.
items.answer: A topic is the subject the writing is about, named in a word or short phrase. A central idea is the main point the author makes about that topic, stated in a full sentence.

steps: A topic answers 'What is this about?' in a word or short phrase, such as 'volcanoes.'
A central idea answers 'What is the main point the author makes about it?' in a full sentence.
The example shows 'volcanoes' as the topic and 'Volcanoes can both destroy land and create new land' as the central idea.
So the difference is that a topic names the subject, while a central idea states the main point about that subject.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Recycling at home is easier than many people think. You can keep one bin for paper and another for cans and bottles. Many cities will pick these up right at the curb. By sorting just a few items, a family can keep a surprising amount of waste out of landfills.

Which of these is the TOPIC of the passage, and which is the CENTRAL IDEA?
1. Recycling at home
2. Recycling at home is simple and can keep a lot of waste out of landfills.
items.answer: Number 1 ('Recycling at home') is the topic. Number 2 ('Recycling at home is simple and can keep a lot of waste out of landfills') is the central idea.

steps: A topic is a short phrase naming the subject.
'Recycling at home' is a short phrase, so it is the topic.
A central idea is a full sentence stating the main point the author develops.
'Recycling at home is simple and can keep a lot of waste out of landfills' is the main point, so it is the central idea.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Deserts are some of the driest places on Earth, yet they are full of life. Cactus plants store water in their thick stems to survive long dry spells. Many desert animals, like the kangaroo rat, get most of their water from the seeds they eat. Some creatures hide underground during the hot day and come out only at night.

Which statement best expresses the central idea of the passage?
items.answer: Even though deserts are very dry, plants and animals have special ways to survive there.

steps: Look for the point that all the details support.
The cactus storing water, the kangaroo rat getting water from seeds, and animals hiding underground are all ways of surviving dryness.
These details build toward one main point about survival in a dry place.
So the central idea is that desert plants and animals have special ways to survive even though deserts are very dry.

items.prompt:

Many sea turtles travel thousands of miles during their lives. After hatching, the tiny turtles swim out into the open ocean. Years later, females often return to the very same beach where they were born to lay their own eggs. Scientists believe the turtles use the Earth's magnetic field to find their way.

The topic of this passage is sea turtles. What is the central idea?
items.answer: Sea turtles make long journeys and can return to the beach where they were born to lay eggs.

steps: The topic is sea turtles, but the central idea is the main point about them.
The details describe long travels, returning to the birth beach, and using the magnetic field to navigate.
These details all show the turtles' remarkable journeys.
So the central idea is that sea turtles make long journeys and can return to the beach where they were born to lay eggs.

Getting enough sleep helps students do their best in school. Sleep gives the brain time to store what was learned during the day. Students who sleep well often focus better and remember more in class. They also tend to feel calmer and get sick less often.

The central idea is that getting enough sleep helps students do well in school. Which detail from the passage BEST supports this central idea?
items.answer: The detail 'Students who sleep well often focus better and remember more in class' best supports the central idea.

steps: The central idea is that sleep helps students do well in school.
Look for the detail that directly connects sleep to school performance.
'Students who sleep well often focus better and remember more in class' ties sleep to focus and memory, which are school skills.
So that detail best supports the central idea.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Penguins are well suited for cold water. A thick layer of fat, called blubber, keeps them warm. Their feathers are packed tightly together and trap a layer of air for warmth. Penguins also huddle together in large groups to share heat during freezing storms.

Which statement best expresses the central idea?
items.answer: Penguins have several features that help them stay warm in cold places.

steps: Find the point all the details support.
Blubber, tightly packed feathers, and huddling together are all ways to stay warm.
The details together build toward one idea about keeping warm.
So the central idea is that penguins have several features that help them stay warm in cold places.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

The public library offers much more than books. Visitors can borrow movies and audiobooks for free. Many libraries have computers and internet for anyone to use. Some even lend tools, musical instruments, and passes to local museums.

Which of these is an OBJECTIVE summary (one that states only what the text says) and which is an OPINION?
1. Everyone should visit the library more often because it is the best place in town.
2. The public library offers many free resources besides books, such as movies, computers, and even tools and museum passes.
items.answer: Number 2 is the objective summary. Number 1 is an opinion.

steps: An objective summary states only what the text says, with no personal judgment.
Number 1 says the library is 'the best place in town' and that 'everyone should visit,' which are opinions not in the text.
Number 2 reports the free resources the passage lists without adding any judgment.
So number 2 is the objective summary and number 1 is an opinion.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Volcanoes can be dangerous, but they also help life. When a volcano erupts, ash and lava can destroy nearby land. Over time, however, that same ash breaks down into rich soil. Farmers near old volcanoes often grow healthy crops in this fertile ground.

Which statement best expresses the central idea?
items.answer: Volcanoes can cause harm, but they can also create rich soil that helps plants grow.

steps: The passage shows two sides: harm from eruptions and benefits from fertile soil.
The central idea must capture both sides, not just one.
The details build toward the point that volcanoes are both harmful and helpful.
So the central idea is that volcanoes can cause harm but can also create rich soil that helps plants grow.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Drinking enough water keeps your body working well. Water helps carry nutrients to your cells. It also keeps your joints moving smoothly and helps control your body temperature. When you do not drink enough, you may feel tired or get a headache.

Write a one-sentence objective summary of this passage.
items.answer: Drinking enough water is important because it helps the body carry nutrients, move joints, and control temperature, while not drinking enough can make you tired or give you a headache.

steps: An objective summary states the central idea and key points without opinion.
The central idea is that drinking enough water keeps the body working well.
The key supporting points are carrying nutrients, moving joints, controlling temperature, and the effects of not drinking enough.
Combine these into one sentence with no personal opinion, such as the answer shown.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Bats are helpful to people in many ways. A single bat can eat thousands of insects in one night, including mosquitoes and crop pests. Some bats spread the seeds of fruit plants as they fly. Others pollinate flowers, much like bees do.

The topic of the passage is bats. Which choice states the CENTRAL IDEA rather than just the topic?
1. Bats
2. Bats help people in several ways, such as eating pests, spreading seeds, and pollinating flowers.
items.answer: Number 2 states the central idea. ('Bats help people in several ways, such as eating pests, spreading seeds, and pollinating flowers.')

steps: Number 1 is a single word, so it is only the topic.
A central idea must be a full sentence stating the main point.
Number 2 states the main point that the details support.
So number 2 states the central idea.

The central idea is that planting trees in a city brings many benefits. Which detail BEST develops this central idea?
items.answer: The detail that trees 'provide shade that keeps streets cooler on hot days' develops the central idea by naming a clear benefit of planting trees.

steps: The central idea is that city trees bring many benefits.

'Trees provide shade that keeps streets cooler on hot days' names a clear benefit.
So this detail best develops the central idea. (The other benefits, cleaning the air and giving animals homes, also support it.)

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Rainforests are home to an amazing variety of life. More kinds of plants and animals live in rainforests than in any other place on Earth. A single tree may hold hundreds of insect species. Scientists are still discovering new creatures there every year.

A student wrote this summary: 'Rainforests have more kinds of plants and animals than anywhere else, and scientists still find new creatures there.' Is this summary objective or does it contain an opinion? Explain.
items.answer: The summary is objective. It states only facts from the passage (that rainforests have the most kinds of life and that scientists still find new creatures) without adding any personal opinion or judgment.

steps: An objective summary reports what the text says without personal feelings or judgments.
The summary repeats facts: rainforests have the most kinds of life, and scientists still find new creatures.
It includes no words like 'best,' 'should,' or 'amazing' added as a personal reaction.
So the summary is objective.

Maple syrup comes from trees. In late winter, farmers drill small holes in maple trees and collect the clear sap that drips out. The sap is then boiled for a long time until most of the water disappears. What is left is the thick, sweet syrup people pour on pancakes.

Which statement best expresses the central idea?
items.answer: Maple syrup is made by collecting sap from maple trees and boiling it down into a thick, sweet liquid.

steps: The details describe each step: drilling holes, collecting sap, and boiling it down.
Together they explain how maple syrup is made.
The central idea must capture this whole process.
So the central idea is that maple syrup is made by collecting sap from maple trees and boiling it down into a thick, sweet liquid.

Exercise is good for more than just your muscles. Moving your body helps your heart grow stronger and pump blood more easily. Exercise can also lift your mood and lower stress. Active kids often sleep better at night too.

Which choice is the best OBJECTIVE summary of the passage?
1. Exercise is wonderful, and lazy people who skip it are making a big mistake.
2. Exercise helps the body in several ways, including strengthening the heart, improving mood, and helping people sleep.
items.answer: Number 2 is the best objective summary. ('Exercise helps the body in several ways, including strengthening the heart, improving mood, and helping people sleep.')

steps: An objective summary states the central idea and key points without opinion.
Number 1 calls exercise 'wonderful' and judges people who skip it, which are opinions not in the text.
Number 2 reports the central idea and the key benefits from the passage with no opinion.
So number 2 is the best objective summary.
